title: Imp in Cauldron Machine
description: A grey, one-eyed imp with a wide grin sits inside a rusty green cauldron mounted on four mechanical spider-like legs. The imp juggles four dark spheres while surrounded by glowing golden magical runes on a sunlit stone patio with potted red flowers and ivy-covered walls.
prompt: A mischievous grey one-eyed imp with sharp teeth and yellow eyes sits inside a large rusty green cauldron that has four long mechanical spider legs. The creature is juggling four dark spheres with both hands raised, standing on a pink stone patio. Bright sunlight casts strong shadows. Potted red geraniums and ivy climb the warm yellow walls in the background. Glowing golden magical runes and circles float in the air around the imp. Whimsical fantasy style, detailed digital painting.
